name: robots/iamaisim__projectairsim
title: Project AirSim drone-landing environment
intro: Project AirSim drone-landing environment, adapted from iamaisim/projectairsim. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
